122.description: This vector represents fragments of Hindi words and characters encoded in a multilingual tokenizer.

159.description: This vector represents character n-grams and subword components characteristic of Hindi text encoding.

171.description: This feature vector represents common Devanagari consonant-vowel conjuncts and syllabic prefixes in Hindi.

75.description: This vector represents common Hindi word suffixes and morphological endings.

45.description: These tokens represent Hindi syllables and consonant-vowel conjuncts commonly used in Devanagari script.

173.description: These tokens represent common subword fragments and characters frequently used in Hindi text encoding.

4.description: This feature vector activates strongly for Hindi text written in the Devanagari script, particularly common consonantal syllables and standalone vowel signs.

28.description: This vector activates on Hindi words and suffixes that feature the vowel sign "ा" combined with various following consonants and vowels.

13.description: They represent Devanagari vowel matras and consonant-vowel combinations combined with punctuation marks.

57.description: This vector activates on various Hindi vowel-sign matras and punctuation marks attached to commas.
